what_it_is: Lamellar 3D titanium cervical interbody cage for ACDF. Lamellar 3D Titanium Technology with 300-500 um longitudinal channels and transverse windows creating interconnected lattice for bony integration. Reverse hourglass design for large graft volume. Bulleted nose for ease of insertion. 3-5 um surface roughness for direct bony ongrowth.
sizing_specs: Full range of sizes. Sagittal lordosis profiles: 0, 7, and 12 degrees.
use_notes: Roughened titanium surfaces shown to demonstrate increased protein expression vs smooth titanium. Now sold by VB Spine.
